claims.claim: Public figures for Brazil's 2025 Web Summit delegation range from 151 to "almost 380".

verdicts.quote: quase 380 empresas
verdicts.note: Sources do give 380 (S1 'quase 380 empresas', S2 '380 empresas') and 151 (S4, 'Das 151 participantes selecionadas pela ApexBrasil'), but 151 is only the ApexBrasil-selected subset, while the delegation totals reported are 340 (S3), 370+ (S4) and about 380, so 151 is not a public figure for the whole delegation.
No source states that delegation figures range from 151 to almost 380, and the figure of 151 refers specifically to participants selected by ApexBrasil rather than the full delegation.

verdicts.quote: Das 151 participantes selecionadas pela ApexBrasil
verdicts.note: S1/S2 support an 'almost 380' delegation figure, but S4 shows 151 is only the number selected by ApexBrasil, not the whole 2025 Brazilian delegation.

claims.claim: Startups.com.br reported on 3 November 2025, quoting ApexBrasil, a figure of 340 startups and innovative companies: 256 selected by ApexBrasil and Sebrae and 84 by partners (Softex, Anprotec, Serpro).

verdicts.note: S3 is dated 03/11/2025 and gives 340 total, 256 selected by ApexBrasil and Sebrae, and 84 chosen by partners such as Softex, Anprotec and Serpro; the figure is attributed to the organisers, and the only direct ApexBrasil quote is from its president on other topics.

verdicts.note: Startups.com.br published these exact figures regarding the delegation on 3 November 2025.
